lines.text: Paul writes to the Galatians with his own hand in large letters.
Those pushing circumcision want to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ, and they boast in the Galatians' freedom.
Paul will boast only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to him.
Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything, but a new creation counts, and Paul wishes wealth and long life on those who walk by this rule.
Paul bears the marks of Jesus on his body and asks that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with their spirit.
